roster.name: Spacelab
roster.note: Europe's first human-spaceflight contribution — a crewed laboratory that flew in the Space Shuttle's payload bay on 22 missions, and carried the first ESA astronaut, Ulf Merbold, in 1983

roster.name: Columbus
roster.note: ESA's permanent research laboratory on the International Space Station — the module that made Europe a full ISS partner with a facility of its own

roster.name: European Service Module
roster.note: ATV technology reborn: Europe now builds the service module that powers and propels NASA's Orion spacecraft on its flights to lunar orbit under Artemis
